rows.note: Use 淨係 as the all-purpose choice for “only” or “merely,” including a deliberately low-key “just.”

example.english: I just want a glass of water.
example.jyutping: ngo5 zing6 hai6 soeng2 jam2 bui1 seoi2

rows.note: Use 啱啱 when something happened moments ago.

example.jyutping: ngo5 ngaam1 ngaam1 sik6 jyun4 faan6

rows.note: Use 啱啱好 when something is exactly or perfectly right.

example.english: This table is just big enough for the three of us.
example.traditional: 呢張枱啱啱好夠我哋三個人坐。
example.jyutping: ni1 zoeng1 toi2 ngaam1 ngaam1 hou2 gau3 ngo5 dei6 saam1 go3 jan4 co5

rows.note: Use 差啲 for a narrowly missed or almost-not outcome.

example.english: I just about forgot to bring my keys.
example.jyutping: ngo5 caa1 di1 m4 gei3 dak1 daai3 so2 si4
